name: train-x.mp4
title: Why is there an X on the last train coach?
caption:
Ever noticed the big yellow X on the last coach of every train? 🚆
It's a safety check. When a train passes a station, the station master looks for that X to make sure the WHOLE train arrived — no coaches left behind.
No X = coaches missing → the next train is stopped.
In the day there's also an LV (Last Vehicle) board, and at night a blinking red lamp.
Send this to the friend who always takes the window in sleeper class 🪟

#indianrailways #trainfacts #didyouknow #whyseries #claudeai

name: why-flights-curve.mp4
title: Why do flights curve?
caption:
Why does your flight bend like a banana instead of going straight? ✈️🌍
Because the Earth is a ball. Pull a string tight from Delhi to New York on a globe and it goes UP over the Arctic. That's the shortest path — a great circle (≈11,750 km).
Flatten the globe into a map and the same string looks curved. The map's "straight" line is actually ≈2,000 km longer.
Bonus: flat maps make Greenland look as big as Africa. Africa is about 14× bigger 🤯
Send this to the friend who always wants the window seat 🪟

#aviation #greatcircle #geography #travelfacts #claudeai

name: resume.mp4
title: 300 applications, 0 calls: the resume fix
caption:
300 applications on Naukri. Zero calls. 😩

The problem isn't you, it's sending the same resume 300 times.

Most companies use software (ATS) that reads your resume before any human does. It looks for words from the job post. No match = no call.

The fix, 2 minutes per job:
1️⃣ Paste the job post + your resume into Claude
2️⃣ Ask what's missing
3️⃣ Rewrite your points with real numbers
⚠️ Only true things. Never fake skills.

Follow @ai.jugaadd + comment RESUME and I'll DM you the exact prompt 📩
